# WC4 · Patient 360 · Tổng quan

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · tab · Next.js: **built (U3)** (`/patients/[id]`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#patient360`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#overview`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#summary`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/care-finance.js#planPanel`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `clinic.js › overview(p)` after `PemaCRMUI.summary(p)`; below it `care-finance.js` adds "Dịch vụ & liệu trình", "Đơn thuốc" and "Đơn thuốc & phiếu tư vấn".
- Hero buttons: "AI brief" (`data-modal=note`), "Nhắn tin" (`data-modal=message`), "Ghi buổi điều trị" (`data-tab=session`).
- Inventory note: Hero (avatar, chips, AI brief, Nhắn tin, Ghi buổi điều trị), tab bar, summary cards, plus the linked workspace panels (Dịch vụ & liệu trình, Đơn thuốc, order history) that care-finance.js injects under every tab except crm and history.
- Page key `patient` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- Controls removed for roles without the capability: `careAction=add-prescription` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=note` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=edit` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=care` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `tab=session` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `careAction=add-service` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant); `careNav=cashier` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant).
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role care: consult, session, photos.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role accountant: consult, session, photos, crm.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"tr[data-patient=\"P001\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"}; it must show "Hồ sơ P001".

## Responsive
- 1440×900 is the reference (Frame, Layout).
- 1920×1020: no layout change
- 1280×720: no layout change
- 1024×768: card .patient-hero: flex-wrap off → on; card .crm-summary: flex-wrap off → on; .patient-layout: grid 2 → 1 columns; .linked-workspace: grid 2 → 1 columns; .sidebar: width 232 → 204px
- 390×844: card .patient-hero: display flex → block; card .crm-summary: flex-wrap off → on; .patient-summary: grid 3 → 2 columns; .panel-head: flex-wrap off → on; card .compare: grid 2 → 1 columns; .patient-layout: display grid → block; card .linked-plan: grid 2 → 1 columns; .linked-total: flex-wrap off → on; .linked-workspace: display grid → block; .sidebar: position fixed → static; .sidebar: width 232 → 390px; .topbar: position sticky → static · hidden: "PHÒNG KHÁM DA LIỄU", "Không gian làm việc", "Quản lý", "Phân tích", "BT", "Chủ phòng khám", "Không gian phòng khám", "/" (+1)
- Overflow per viewport from the screenshots: `pema-agent/frontend/visual-ref/old/manifest.json` (W1), when present.

- "Ảnh minh họa tổng hợp cho prototype. Ảnh lâm sàng thật cần gắn vùng chụp, tư thế, thời điểm và đồng ý sử dụng."

## Differences from the app design
- App F1 is a vertical list of cards (care, session, next visit, tiền thủ thuật, links to tabs); the web hero, tab bar, three summary figures, journey timeline, milestone photos, AI brief, facts and linked panels are all on one wide page.
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in F1: "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP"
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in F1: "Ảnh minh họa tổng hợp cho prototype. Ảnh lâm sàng thật cần gắn vùng chụp, tư thế, thời điểm và đồng ý sử dụng."
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in F1: "Chăm sóc và phục hồi sau buổi điều trị"

## Gotchas
- Opening a patient from the list is a row click (`tr[data-patient]`) or the "Mở →" button; the tab is kept in the module variable `tab`, so a re-render keeps it.
- The brief on this tab is the text of the AI brief dialog (WC13); "AI chỉ là bản nháp": the doctor must edit and approve it.

- Frames: 1440x900, 1920x1020, 390x844 (inventory: 1440x900, 1920x1020, 390x844); screen label `WC4 · Patient 360 · Tổng quan`.
